customizablehud.editor.hint: Drag modules to move · Arrows: 1px · Shift+Arrows: 5px · Esc: Done
customizablehud.tooltip.language.english: Displays all Customizable HUD screens, tooltips, and HUD labels in English without restarting or changing Minecraft's language.
customizablehud.tooltip.language.spanish: Displays all Customizable HUD screens, tooltips, and HUD labels in Spanish without restarting or changing Minecraft's language.
customizablehud.tooltip.module.armor_on: Armor HUD is active and shown in-game according to your visibility settings.
customizablehud.tooltip.module.armor_off: Armor HUD is hidden in-game. Its position and style settings are preserved.
customizablehud.tooltip.module.effects_o: Effects HUD is active and shown in-game when you have status effects.
Effects HUD is hidden in-game. Your layout and color settings are preserved.
customizablehud.tooltip.configure_armor: Open Armor HUD settings: durability metric, color ranges, hands, spacing, and live preview.
customizablehud.tooltip.configure_effect: Open Effects HUD settings: appearance, background/border toggles, sorting, per-effect colors, and preview.
customizablehud.tooltip.open_editor: Open the interactive drag-and-drop editor to move, snap, scale, and test both HUD modules.
customizablehud.tooltip.preset.vanilla_c: Compact vanilla-framed slots and compact effect rows near default positions.
customizablehud.tooltip.preset.compact_t: Minimal borderless percentages and clean text-focused effect rows.
customizablehud.tooltip.preset.expanded_: Larger slots with item names, durability points, and clean card effect readouts.
customizablehud.tooltip.apply_preset: Apply the selected quick preset to both Armor HUD and Effects HUD while keeping language and custom effect colors.
customizablehud.tooltip.hide_inventory_o: Hide custom HUD modules while your inventory or container screen is open.
Keep custom HUD modules visible behind inventory and container screens.
customizablehud.tooltip.hide_chat_on: Hide custom HUD modules while typing or viewing chat.
customizablehud.tooltip.hide_chat_off: Keep custom HUD modules visible while the chat overlay is open.
customizablehud.tooltip.hide_pause_on: Hide custom HUD modules while the pause menu is open.
customizablehud.tooltip.hide_pause_off: Keep custom HUD modules visible behind the pause menu.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor_guides_on: Show alignment guidelines against screen center, edges, hotbar, and the other HUD module while dragging.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor_guides_of: Disable alignment guidelines while dragging in the Visual HUD Editor.
customizablehud.tooltip.reset_all: Reset every module, visibility rule, and layout back to defaults.
customizablehud.tooltip.save_now: Immediately write all current changes to config/customizablehud.json.
customizablehud.tooltip.close_screen: Save any pending edits and close this configuration screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.back_screen: Save any pending edits and return to the previous screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.toggle_preview: Show or hide the interactive live HUD preview panel on this screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.hotbar_le: Anchors the HUD just to the left of the vanilla hotbar (avoids overlapping offhand when empty).
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.hotbar_ri: Anchors the HUD just to the right of the vanilla hotbar.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.center_le: Anchors the HUD centered vertically on the left edge of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.center_ri: Anchors the HUD centered vertically on the right edge of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.center_bo: Anchors the HUD centered horizontally above the hotbar.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.top_left: Anchors the HUD in the top-left corner of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.top_right: Anchors the HUD in the top-right corner of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.bottom_le: Anchors the HUD in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.bottom_ri: Anchors the HUD in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.anchor.custom: Uses the exact screen position set in the Visual HUD Editor.
customizablehud.tooltip.orientation.hori: Arranges items side by side in a horizontal row.
customizablehud.tooltip.orientation.vert: Stacks items from top to bottom in a vertical column.
Shows only remaining durability percentage above each icon (e.g., 85%).
Shows only remaining durability points above each icon (e.g., 342).
Hides numeric durability text; you can still rely on the bar or icon.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.enabled_on: Armor HUD is enabled and renders on screen during gameplay.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.enabled_of: Armor HUD is disabled. Preview uses sample items only without showing in-game.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.style.vani: Draws classic compact hotbar-sized slot frames around each item.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.style.inve: Draws standard inventory-style slot borders and backgrounds.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.style.mini: Draws subtle dark translucent backing behind each slot.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.style.bord: Draws items and text without any slot box or border.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.scale: Resizes the Armor HUD icons and labels uniformly (currently %s).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.spacing: Gap in GUI pixels between adjacent armor items (currently %s px; 0 gives compact hotbar spacing).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.show_icon_: Displays the item icon inside each armor or hand slot.
Hides item icons and shows only durability readouts.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.hide_empty: Omits empty armor slots so only equipped items take space.
Keeps empty armor slots visible as placeholders.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.show_bar_o: Draws the durability progress bar colored consistently with your Healthy/Warning/Critical ranges.
Hides the durability bar below each item icon.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.show_max_o: Appends max durability when Points Only is selected (e.g., 342/407).
Shows only remaining points when Points Only is selected.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.show_name_: Shows each item's name (including custom anvil names) above its metric without overlapping.
Hides item names to keep the Armor HUD compact.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.color_rang: Colors durability text and bar based on remaining percentage: Healthy > Warning%, Warning between Critical+1% and Warning%, Critical <= Critical%.
Uses neutral white durability text and standard bar colors instead of threshold colors.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.warning_th: Remaining durability <= %s%% turns Warning color (must stay above Critical %s%%).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.critical_t: Remaining durability <= %s%% turns Critical color (must stay below Warning %s%%).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.color_heal: Click to cycle the readable color used for Healthy armor durability (> Warning threshold).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.color_warn: Click to cycle the readable color used for Warning armor durability (<= Warning and > Critical).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.color_crit: Click to cycle the readable color used for Critical armor durability (<= Critical threshold).
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.low_warnin: Blinks armor slots that fall into the Critical threshold.
Keeps Critical armor slots steady without blinking.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.main_hand_: Displays your held main-hand item alongside the Armor HUD.
Hides your main-hand item from the Armor HUD.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.off_hand_o: Displays your off-hand item alongside the Armor HUD.
Hides your off-hand item from the Armor HUD.
customizablehud.tooltip.reverse_order: Click to reverse the display order of Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.swap_pair: Swap these two adjacent slots in the armor piece order.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.individual: Each armor and hand slot can be positioned independently in the Visual HUD Editor.
All armor and hand slots move together as one aligned group.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.reset_indi: Resets custom per-slot offsets back to zero.
customizablehud.tooltip.armor.reset_modu: Resets all Armor HUD settings back to defaults.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.enabled_: Effects HUD is enabled and displays active status effects during gameplay.
Effects HUD is disabled. Preview shows sample effects without activating the HUD.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.style.mi: Compact Minecraft-inspired rows for active status effects.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.style.cl: Smooth dark cards with a thin left category/custom accent stripe.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.style.mi: Clean text-first layout without thick framing.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.show_bac: Draws the filled background behind each effect entry (independent from border).
Renders effect entries with a transparent background (border can still be toggled).
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.show_bor: Draws the border/outline around each effect entry (independent from background).
Hides the outer border/outline around each effect entry.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.vanilla_: Shows both Customizable HUD's Effects HUD and Minecraft's built-in status icons.
Shows only Customizable HUD's Effects HUD and hides Minecraft's built-in status icons.
Shows only Minecraft's built-in status icons and hides the custom Effects HUD.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.spacing: Vertical or horizontal gap in GUI pixels between effect rows (currently %s px).
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.show_ico: Displays each effect's original untinted sprite icon.
Hides effect icons to make rows narrower.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.show_nam: Displays the localized effect name (custom colors apply to text only).
Hides effect names and shows only icon and timer.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.show_dur: Displays remaining effect time (or infinity symbol for permanent effects).
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.show_lev: Displays effect amplifier level alongside the name.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.hide_lev: Omits level I so only level II and higher display an amplifier.
Displays level I as well as higher levels.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.level_fo: Formats effect amplifiers as Roman numerals (I, II, III, IV...).
Formats effect amplifiers as Arabic numbers (1, 2, 3, 4...).
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.without_: Includes ambient or particle-free beacon/conduit effects.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.group_ca: Groups beneficial, neutral, and harmful effects together.
Lists all active effects in one combined list.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.sort.cat: Orders effects by category (beneficial/neutral/harmful) and then alphabetically.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.sort.dur: Places effects closest to expiring at the top.
Places longest-lasting and permanent effects at the top.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.sort.nam: Orders active effects alphabetically by display name.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.sort.non: Preserves the order reported by Minecraft.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.fade_low: Subtly pulses alpha when an effect has 5 seconds or less remaining.
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.color_du: Recolors duration timers to yellow (<15s) or red (<5s) when no custom effect color overrides it.
Keeps standard timer color unless a per-effect custom color is active.
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors: Assign custom text colors to any vanilla or modded effect (name and timer only; icons stay untinted).
customizablehud.tooltip.effects.reset_mo: Resets Effects HUD appearance and behavior settings back to defaults.
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors.se: Filter effects by display name or namespaced ID (e.g., minecraft:regeneration).
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors.to: Enable a custom text color for this effect while leaving its icon untinted.
Custom color is active for this effect. Click to disable it temporarily without losing the saved hex.
Custom color is paused but its hex code is saved. Click to re-enable.
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors.sw: Apply %s (%s) to the selected effect's name and timer.
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors.he: Enter a 6-digit hex color (#RRGGBB or RRGGBB) for the selected effect.
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors.ap: Validate and apply the typed #RRGGBB color to the selected effect.
customizablehud.tooltip.effect_colors.re: Remove the custom color override for this effect and restore its default text color.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.target: Switch active selection between Armor HUD and Effects HUD.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.toggle_en: Enable or disable the currently selected HUD module.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.scale: Scale the selected HUD module uniformly (currently %s).
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.scale_inp: Type an exact scale factor between 0.50 and 2.50.
customizablehud.tooltip.move_toolbar: Move the editor toolbar between the bottom and top of the screen.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.individua: Toggle moving armor and hand slots individually or as one group.
customizablehud.tooltip.auto_layout: Reset selected module back to default anchor, scale, and automatic layout.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.snap: Toggle grid snapping and alignment guides while dragging.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.cancel: Discard layout edits made in this editor session and restore the previous layout.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.save_layo: Persist the current HUD layout to config/customizablehud.json immediately.
customizablehud.tooltip.editor.done: Save pending layout changes and exit the Visual HUD Editor.
customizablehud.message.config_recovered: [Customizable HUD] Damaged config was backed up and default settings were restored.
